body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the validated-lead program for your listing-to-contact flows. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context from the earlier emails for when it becomes useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN classifieds: references prior email and earlier stages so the cascade reads as one thread; direct close with easy out (releases prospect if timing is wrong); no figure; 0 question marks; no sign-off; native UK English; no em-dash, no 'X, not Y'.
